name: orchplus
summary: Conversation-first orchestration for concurrent projects, plans and agent conversations through SPAWN. ORCHESTRATED WORK groups conversations beneath named projects, with explicit START decisions, review and release-manager landing, durable recovery and optional USAGE capacity routing. Provider-native orchestration is often the best choice for work that does not need this shared coordination. Package version is defined in plugin.toml; this descriptor does not assert completed platform qualification.
way_in: Open ORCH+ from Tern's command palette, choose New orchestration, name it and select an eligible orchestrator. Describe work in its conversation; use the adjacent ORCHESTRATED WORK panel for projects and conversations. Settings and Advanced hold configuration and diagnostics.
scope: Host-local: the controller, coordinator, workers, mailboxes and SPAWN records live on one Tern host. To orchestrate agents on a remote host, attach a Tern window to that host and open ORCH+ there. No SSH hop, no transcript reading.
